title: I-oon's More Content Mod
description: This mod adds 8* new mobs, 3 new weapons, 1 new ore, and some new items.
body:
This is my very first mod. This mod adds 8 new mobs (plus one I haven't finished yet), 4 new weapons, 1 new ore, and some new items. Made in **Mcreator**.

You should download this mod if you want to have more mobs to play around with or if you want a fast ocean floor mount.

**Some of the new mobs**

-Crystaliz
(found in dripstone caves and gives you access to the crystal block. which is a new pink building block.)

-Moss Golem
(found in lush caves and drops moss and a spore blossom when killed.)

-Giant Moss Golem
(like the moss golem but will attack attackers. drops additional stone when killed.)

-Sea Cucumber
(is able to be bred with seagrass or kelp. is fast on the ocean floor, thus making it a great sea floor mount.)




To install, you need **Neoforge** with **minecraft version 1.21.8**




_Ps: you can vaporize creepers in the mod with the Creeper Vaporizer Rod._
